Read and validate a .statci.yml project configuration file

Source: R/config.R
read_statci_config.Rd

Parses a YAML configuration file strictly with eval.expr = FALSE (blocking arbitrary R code evaluation during YAML loading) and validates all fields against the statci configuration schema, including enabled/disabled lint rules, severity overrides, exclude patterns, manuscript/model paths, report targets, and CI gate thresholds.

Usage

read_statci_config(path = ".statci.yml")

Arguments

path

Path to a .statci.yml (or custom YAML) configuration file.

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_config" containing normalized lint, manuscript, gate, report, and source fields.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".yml")
writeLines(c(
  "version: 1",
  "lint:",
  "  paths: [R]",
  "  exclude_rules: [cor_without_use_arg]",
  "gate:",
  "  fail_on: fail"
), tmp)
cfg <- read_statci_config(tmp)
cfg
#> <statci_config> (source: file197fa38ee1c.yml)
#> lint paths: R
#> excluded rules: cor_without_use_arg
#> gate fail_on: fail
unlink(tmp)
